name: Rose
source:
Rose's full name is Rosemary White, and she's the leading member of the Time Tenshi field team while they're on-mission. The large, glowing machine you see behind her in this picture is the Time Window: the incredible invention that allows its users to travel through time!

Rose is from England and has beautiful long, blonde hair with distinctive heterochromatic eyes - one is green and the other is orange. This alludes to the two-fold nature of the Time Tenshi's adventures; some take place in the present day, but others happen in a completely different era!

She's a good cook and a highly intelligent biologist. She's quite ladylike and refined for the most part, but she can sometimes lose her cool and get a bit passionate in the middle of a heated confrontation or a battle situation.

She has two other outfits that'll appear in game - a Time Window facility uniform, like the one Michelle's wearing in her character profile image, and a more relaxed casual outfit for social occasions.

Lastly, she doesn't use a shield despite her knightly fighting style, but she always carries her signature winged sword into battle. It can pack quite a punch with a single swing, and she's definitely got both the sword arm and the training to use it!

-From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/silvercow/time-tenshi-time-travelling-anime-visual-novel/posts/2730082]Time Tenshi Kickstarter Update #2[/url]
